verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'resilient partitioning logic and robust visibility' and job APIs that let you 'inspect any files that failed during processing,' implying some fault-tolerance and failure tracking, but there is no direct evidence on handling thousand-page documents, multi-gigabyte files, timeout limits, or absence of silent truncation. Missing for 10: benchmarks or docs on large-file/long-document throughput, explicit timeout/retry handling, and independent confirmation of no truncation on large inputs.
